Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Bind
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Fix an enemy to the ground with a surge of Adhesion. Their feet stick as if the stone itself has reached up to grab them. They can still swing a weapon, still shout, still breathe, but they cannot take a single step. The binding holds for a time that grows longer as your oaths deepen.
